description: This PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_Injector_PurifierLinkify' defines an injector component for the HTMLPurifier library that converts configuration directives with a specific syntax (%Namespace.Directive) into clickable links in HTML content. It provides methods to prepare the injector with configuration data and to handle text tokens, replacing matched directives with anchor tags linking to specified URLs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_PurifierLinkify
classes.description: PHP class that implements an injector to parse and convert custom directive syntax into links within HTML content.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the injector by fetching the documentation URL from configuration and calling the parent prepare method.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Processes a text token to identify and convert configuration directives into clickable links, if allowed.
